Kirjasto lainaa muutakin kuin kirjoja

Kirjastosta voi lainata kirjoja, elokuvia ja musiikkia, mutta monessa suomalaisessa kirjastossa on nykyään paljon muutakin. Esimerkiksi Järvelän kirjastosta saa lainaksi työkaluja, suksia ja jopa kitaroita.

Mistä ajatus lainata työkaluja tuli?

  1. Kaupungin päättäjiltä.
  2. Kirjaston asiakkailta.
  3. Toisesta kirjastosta.

The test

What the intermediate test asks

YKI is run by the Finnish National Agency for Education (Opetushallitus). You choose a level when you register and take all four subtests at that level on one day; at the intermediate level (keskitaso) the day takes about five hours with breaks.

SubtestWhat you doIn Glossa's papers
Reading (tekstin ymmärtäminen)News, articles, opinion pieces, notices and advertisements, with multiple-choice, true/false and open questions answered in Finnish.The same task types, with fewer texts. 40 minutes, a time Glossa sets because the board does not publish one.
Listening (puheen ymmärtäminen)Interviews, conversations, news and short everyday situations, each played twice, with the same question types.The same task types, with fewer recordings. 25 minutes.
Writing (kirjoittaminen)Three guided texts of different kinds, such as a formal email and an opinion for an online forum.All three tasks and the full 55 minutes, rated by AI against the published YKI writing criteria.
Speaking (puhuminen)Tasks recorded in a language studio.Not included: Glossa cannot assess free speech the way YKI's raters do. The course's conversation practice covers the same everyday situations.

Based on the Finnish National Agency for Education's and the University of Jyväskylä's published test descriptions, checked in October 2026. From 2027 the Finnish and Swedish tests are to be taken on a computer at the test centre.

Finnish citizenship

What citizenship asks of the test

For Finnish citizenship you take the intermediate test in Finnish or Swedish and need at least grade 3 (B1) in two subtests, in one of these pairs:

  • speaking and writing,
  • listening and writing, or
  • reading and speaking.

What you get

Papers to practise on, and a course to learn from

  • 1

    Two papers at each level

    Basic (A1–A2), intermediate (B1–B2) and advanced (C1–C2), with original texts and recordings on YKI's topic areas: housing, work, health, services, the environment and society.

  • 2

    Writing rated against the criteria

    Your three texts are rated by AI against the published YKI writing criteria, with what to improve. It is an estimate, not a rater's grade.

  • 3

    A full course behind the papers

    76 modules in eight tiers from A1 to C1, with the cases, consonant gradation, the passive and spoken Finnish explained directly, so a weak spot in a paper has a module to go back to.

  • 4

    Feedback that says why

    Every answer in the course gets feedback with a reason and a link to the grammar rule. Every Finnish word can be tapped for its forms, meaning and audio.

Honest limits

How the practice papers differ from the real test

  • No grade is given. YKI turns points into levels with its own scale, which Glossa does not know, so a paper shows the share of points only and cannot tell you whether you would reach grade 3.
  • Reading and listening are shorter than the real subtests, in the same task types.
  • There is no speaking subtest.
  • Recordings can be replayed. In the test you hear each one twice, so play it twice and then answer.
  • Words can be tapped for their meaning while you practise; the real test allows no dictionary.

Questions

Common questions

Is Glossa an official YKI preparation course?
No. Glossa is not connected with the Finnish National Agency for Education or the University of Jyväskylä. The papers follow their published test descriptions, with original content.
Which level do I need for citizenship?
The intermediate level (keskitaso), with at least grade 3 in one of the pairs above. The Finnish Immigration Service decides on citizenship and sets the other conditions.
What is free?
The whole Finnish course from A1 to C1, the grammar reference and word practice are free. The YKI practice papers, conversation practice, stories and the other extras are part of Premium.
I speak Russian. Is there a course for me?
Yes. Finnish for Russian speakers has the same YKI papers, with the instructions and explanations in Russian.
